title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ActuatorLevel
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ActuatorLevel. Independent from the ActuatorSwitch class, the ActuatorLevel class enables a user or application to model LEVEL commands (start, up, percentageAbsolute, relative, etc.). This can be used to dim a light, set the speed of an electric motor, etc. Subclass of Actuator (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Actuator, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ActuatorLevel'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
